title: pcf-quadratic-growth: An exact growth constant for the quadratic polynomial continued fraction (structural proof; numerically verified)
description:
A structural proof, with full numerical verification, of the exact two-sided growth law for the convergent denominators qn of the quadratic polynomial continued fraction V(A,B,C) = 1 + Kn≥1 1/(An2+Bn+C), for integers A,B,C ≥ 1. With bk = Ak2+Bk+C and the standard continuant q0=1, q1=b1, qn=bnqn-1+qn-2,

log qn = n log A + 2 log(n!) + (B/A) log n + (KΓ + δ) + κ/n + O(1/n2),

where KΓ = −log(Γ(1−r1)Γ(1−r2)) is the elementary naive-product constant (r1,r2 the roots of Ax2+Bx+C; at B=0 equal to log(sinh(π√(C/A))/(π√(C/A)))), δ = log R∞ > 0 with R∞ = lim qn/∏k≤n bk is a strictly positive continued-fraction correction from the +qn-2 term, and κ = (1/2)(B2/A2 + B/A − 2C/A).

Framing. This sharpens the deposited one-sided denominator-growth bound log Qn ≥ n log n − O(n) (which is all Euler's irrationality criterion needs, and which underlies the deposited 482-constant catalogue) to an exact expansion through O(1/n) with an explicit additive constant. The leading 2 log(n!) reproduces the deposited leading order; the present work additionally fixes every lower-order term and the constant.

Epistemic status (SIARC four-class). STRUCTURAL — complete elementary hand proof (product/Gamma identity + monotone-bounded scaled recurrence), modulo one standard cited asymptotic (the DLMF 5.11.13 Gamma-ratio expansion, equation numbers verified against the live release), not yet machine-checked in Lean. VERIFIED — every proof step confirmed numerically (mpmath, 50–60 digits) on seven triples; the B=0 cross-check KΓ = sinh form holds to 50 digits. CONJECTURED — δ is non-elementary; an 80-digit PSLQ search for the single triple (1,0,1) against a natural constant basis returns no relation (suggestive for that case/basis, not a general theorem). A PROVEN upgrade (clean Lean axiom cone) is identified as future work via the conditional-core pattern (Gamma/Stirling asymptotics taken as a labelled hypothesis).
